notes.title: Major Demo Update: Quality of Life, Gameplay Changes, New Balance. and More!
notes.notes: [p]Hello, survivors![/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]A huge update for the Nested Lands Demo is now live! We’ve added a great deal of QoL features, optimisations, and many other things, which will greatly improve your life in Norovellier.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44676545/b5ff33ac7fc6da1de235537b9066c03910086e46.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p align="justify"][b]Very important[/b]: the demo was completely redone, and many quests and locations were updated, so you would need to start a new game. The new demo will also be longer, with new quests.[/p][p][/p][p align="justify"][b]Added a brand new game mechanic - Plague Wind[/b][/p][p align="justify"]During the plague wind, the current plague spots will change and the new plague plants will appear across the land. Make sure to hide from it, so you don’t risk infection. [/p][p][/p][p align="justify"][b]UI Changes[/b][/p][p align="justify"]We have made major UI updates across the board. All of the old UI is gone and replaced by a new, modern one. We are welcoming everyone to try it and leave us feedback for further adjustments.[/p][p][/p][p align="justify"][b]Village and Villagers[/b][/p][p align="justify"]Greatly improved how villagers interact with each other and the player;[/p][p align="justify"]Added new idle activities for villagers;[/p][p align="justify"]Added new animations for villagers (eating, drinking, resting, praying, and more);[/p][p align="justify"]Added new voicelines for villagers. [/p][p align="justify"]We’ve made a brand new UI for village management and improved villager status icons. [/p][p][/p][p align="justify"][b]General NPC improvements[/b][/p][p align="justify"]All NPCs will have torches in their hands at night;[/p][p align="justify"]Added new voicelines for enemies; [/p][p align="justify"]Added new animations for all NPCs;[/p][p align="justify"]We’ve changed how raids work: enemies will raid your village from time to time, trying to kill the villagers and to steal your items. You will need to have someone on Guard Watch to defend your land;[/p][p align="justify"]Added enemy patrols in several areas. [/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]In general, we’ve greatly improved how NPCs behave while idle and while working, fighting or talking. There’s a lot of new animations and improvements, like the new dismemberment mechanic - with every killing blow, there’s a chance for a fatality animation of sorts. We won’t list all animation changes, as it would be a bit long and boring and it’s best to see them all in the game. [/p][p][/p][p align="justify"][b]Day and Night Changes[/b][/p][p align="justify"]It will get cold around 11PM now;[/p][p align="justify"]Night is a bit brighter than before; [/p][p align="justify"]Updated the transition between day and night time, it is much smoother now.[/p][p][/p][p align="justify"][b]Player Improvements[/b][/p][p align="justify"]Improved jump;[/p][p align="justify"]Changed how stealth works: no more separate stealth bars per each enemy. Now all enemies will seek the player actively and everyone will join the battle if you are spotted;[/p][p align="justify"]If you pick up all items from a chest, the loot window will close automatically now;[/p][p align="justify"]Added a keyboard shortcut for “get all” button in chests;[/p][p align="justify"]Bottle icons will change according to the liquid it contains. [/p][p][/p][p align="justify"][b]Graphical Changes[/b][/p][p align="justify"]New shoreline wave animations on the beach;[/p][p align="justify"]Improved rain visuals;[/p][p align="justify"]Improved plague fog visuals;[/p][p align="justify"]Updated the graphics for buildings.[/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]There’s a lot of other important under-the-hood changes in the demo as well! It will be a brand new experience and we are inviting everyone to try the Nested Lands Demo one more time. [/p][p][/p][p]Don't forget to wishlist and follow Nested Lands![/p][p][/p][p]Enjoy the demo!  [/p]

notes.title: Nested Lands Demo 0.7.2.13 Update is live
notes.notes:
[p]Dear survivors![/p][p][/p][p]A huge and awaited update for the demo has arrive! We’ve made tons of changes, improvements, and tweaks — all shaped by your feedback. Now it’s your turn to dive back in and let us know what you think!

Remember: your voice matters, and we always follow your requests, so feel free to quote on Discord and Steam.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Changes[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Features[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Added naked villager models (yes, with genitals)[/p][/*][*][p]New NPCs footstep VFX[/p][/*][*][p]New VFX foot track ton for the NPCs[/p][/*][*][p]Added mouse sensitivity and motion blur options[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new heavy attack for the player [/p][/*][*][p]Added new voice-over and text messages on all random events and now your character speaks when interacting with dead animals for the first time;[/p][/*][*][p]Added new player character voice-over for day/night cycle, looting and Village Management;[/p][/*][*][p]Now your character consumes stamina on block and has better block detection based on attack direction.[/p][/*][*][p]Added torches for the NPCs[/p][/*][*][p]Added new items into the looting spots[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][b]Fixes[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Localization updates[/p][/*][*][p]Various graphical changes and improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Tons of optimization and bugfixes[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the village management system[/p][/*][*][p]Various balance fixes with the Plague[/p][/*][*][p]Various balance fixes for the village[/p][/*][*][p]Changed Stone Spear damage from 130 to 80; Throwing Spear damage from 30 to 80;[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Plague Medicine find chance (50 to 90 in some loot places);[/p][/*][*][p]NPC graphics improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Removed some useless quests[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Plague spot interaction time so that a player could avoid catching a Plague for the first time[/p][/*][*][p]Changed rain and fog chances to appear[/p][/*][*][p]Various village immersion changes

Overall, more than 150 fixes and changes were made and we will be happy to hear your thoughts about it.
[/p][/*][/list][h2]
How can I share my feedback?[/h2][p]Join our Discord server for real-time support, updates, and more. You can leave your feedback there and seek help from the devs and fellow players.[/p][p]If you have any questions or need assistance, don’t hesitate to tag our community manager @lutra_lutra for help.[/p][p]You can also post on the Steam Community Hub, where our team is actively monitoring feedback.[/p][p]After you test the game, we will ask you to[url="https://www.surveymonkey.com/r/NestedLandsDemo"] complete a survey[/url] on your impressions and rate different aspects of the game. This feedback will help us improve Nested Lands and enhance your future gaming experience. You will find the link to the survey in the game menu. We will also remind you about it and post the link on our Discord and Steam accounts.[/p][h2]
A Demo Is a Work in Progress[/h2][p]The Nestled Lands Demo represents an early glimpse into the world we are building. While it's fully playable, please note that many features and systems are still under active development. For example:[/p][list][*][p]Multiplayer is not available yet[/p][/*][*][p]Only a limited number of biomes can be explored[/p][/*][*][p]Some enemies are not included[/p][/*][*][p]Difficulty settings (easy, medium, hard, custom) are not implemented (the demo runs on a single preset difficulty)[/p][/*][*][p]The quest system is being actively expanded and refined[/p][/*][*][p]NPCs are undergoing some polish (facial animations, voice acting, etc.)[/p][/*][*][p]…more changes and refinements are in the works at this very moment![/p][/*][/list][p]This is just the beginning! As development continues, much more new content will be added, existing content polished, and gameplay depth enhanced. We appreciate your patience and feedback, and we are excited to share more with you in the future![/p][p][/p][h2]Thanks for Playing![/h2][p]Your support and feedback during the demo phase mean everything to us. Nestled Lands is being shaped by players just like you, actively improved with the community’s help. And we’re just getting started.[/p][p]Stay vigilant,  [b]– The Nested Lands Team[/b][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Alpha Update 0.7.12
notes.notes:
Hello Survivors,

We've been listening to your feedback, and Update 0.7.12 brings several improvements and fixes based on your reports! From better UI navigation to refining core mechanics like sleep and item consumption, this update is all about making your journey in Norovellir smoother and more immersive.

[h2]Improvements & Fixes
[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added tab menu navigation UI
[*] Improved codex organization for better readability and quicker access to important information.
[*] Players can no longer interact while swimming, preventing unintended actions.
[*] Improved quickslot functionality
[*] Item сonsumption feedback is now clearer, so you always know when an item has been used successfully
[*] Fixed an issue where players could climb trees (unintended, though impressive)
[*] Reduced the spread of plague among villagers, making settlements more sustainable
[*] Players can now select the number of hours to sleep
[*] Sleep balance adjusted to better reflect fatigue and recovery
[*] Game now saves automatically after sleeping, securing progress
[*] Your plugged-in controller should no longer block you from using keyboard and mouse
[*] Now you can equip bow while crouched and stealth kill using the bow
[*] Fixed problem of quickslot UI appearing sometimes and not being able to close it
[*] Fixed several visual inconsistencies on autocrafters UI
[*] Fixed Wash Tub graphics
[*] Esc button now can be used to close quickslot view
[*] Now game saves while sleeping too
[*] Player now use 30% less energy on doing stuff (0.1 to 0.07)
[*] Implemented the new Blacksmith workshop, Builder´s Hut, Carpenter workshop and Weaver workshop
[/list]

We highly encourage all participants of the Alpha to [url=https://www.surveymonkey.com/r/NestedLands]fill out our survey[/url] — it won’t take more than 5 minutes of your time but will help us immensely with the development and further improvements. As always, thank you for your continued support! Keep exploring, surviving, and helping us shape Nested Lands.

Join the discussion and report bugs in our [url=https://discord.gg/GQ2WAjmxj2]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: Update 0.7.0.9 for Alpha Test
notes.notes:
Welcome, Survivors!

We've made some improvements, fixed bugs, and added new features to enhance your Nested Lands experience. Thank you for your continued feedback and support as we refine the game.
Here's what's new in this update:

[h2]New Features & Improvements
[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added quickslot inputs (1-8), allowing players to use items directly without opening the interface.
[*] Shields can now be placed in quick slots for easier access.
[*] When using an item from a quickslot, the interface will now close automatically.
[*] Implemented tab navigation in the Village Management interface.
[*] Removed gamepad deadzone.
[*] Streamer mode option added to the settings.
[*] Added FPS Limit to the game
[/list]


[h2]Bug Fixes 
[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added colliders to simple chest structures.
[*] Fixed localization issues in multiple areas, including:
[*] Farm station buttons
[*] NPC profession names
[*] Interaction labels for wells and rivers
[*] Resolved an issue where animals would run away from the player.
[*] Fixed Balder’s hair.
[*] Adjusted the Build Tool panel so it no longer overlaps with player status conditions.
[*] Fixed an issue where the player could climb invisible walls.
[*] The player can no longer dodge while using a bow.
[*] Trees no longer spin when being cut down.
[*] Fixed camera control issues when using a gamepad.
[*] Resolved UI problems with the Bug Reporter tool.
[*] Adjusted input code for walking and running for better responsiveness.
[*] Fixed an issue where a video tutorial would display the last frame when switching topics.
[*] If a loot setup item is a recipient and has no liquid stored, its charge value will now always be 0.
[*] Fixed an issue with the villager recruitment process in advanced save files
[/list]

Thank you for playing Nested Lands! Your feedback helps shape the game as we continue development. We highly encourage all participants of the Alpha to [url=https://www.surveymonkey.com/r/NestedLands]fill out our survey[/url] — it won’t take more than 5 minutes of your time but will help us immensely with the development and further improvements.

Stay tuned for more updates, and let us know what you think in [url=https://discord.com/invite/Z7dVs8BPkh]our Discord[/url].
Happy surviving!
